content.content:
# Acme Storefront

A static shop site: six pages in `site/`, styles in `site/css/`, scripts in `site/js/`.

- `npm start` serves the site on http://127.0.0.1:$PORT (the `PORT` variable is set).
- `npx playwright test tests/functional.spec.ts` runs the functional tests.
- `npx playwright test tests/visual.spec.ts` compares each page, at desktop and phone size, with approved baselines; results are in `visual-report/results.json` and the `testivai` tools.

Dependencies are installed. There is no network access.

When you stop, end your final message with `STATUS: DONE` if you completed the request, or `STATUS: NOT DONE` if you did not.
# Acme Storefront

A small static shop site: six pages, shared CSS, no build step.

```
site/
  index.html  products.html  pricing.html  orders.html  about.html  contact.html
  css/tokens.css      design tokens and the web font
  css/base.css        reset, typography, layout
  css/components.css  header, button, card, form, table, modal
  css/pages.css       page sections
  js/app.js           mobile menu, order dialog, forms
  assets/  fonts/
tests/functional.spec.ts
```

## Run

```bash
npm install
npm start        # http://127.0.0.1:4173
npm test         # functional tests (Playwright)
```

The layout has one breakpoint, at 720px.
import { defineConfig, devices } from '@playwright/test';

const port = Number(process.env.PORT ?? 4173);

export default defineConfig({
  testDir: './tests',
  fullyParallel: false,
  workers: 1,
  retries: 0,
  reporter: [['list'], ['@testivai/witness-playwright/reporter']],
  use: { baseURL: `http://127.0.0.1:${port}` },
  projects: [
    { name: 'functional', testMatch: 'functional.spec.ts', use: { ...devices['Desktop Chrome'] } },
    { name: 'desktop', testMatch: 'visual.spec.ts', use: { browserName: 'chromium', viewport: { width: 1280, height: 800 }, deviceScaleFactor: 1 } },
    { name: 'phone', testMatch: 'visual.spec.ts', use: { browserName: 'chromium', viewport: { width: 390, height: 844 }, deviceScaleFactor: 1 } },
  ],
  webServer: {
    command: 'node server.js',
    url: `http://127.0.0.1:${port}`,
    reuseExistingServer: false,
    env: { PORT: String(port) },
    timeout: 30_000,
  },
});

Fixed. Here's what happened and what I changed.

**What happened:** The `@font-face` rule in `site/css/tokens.css:5` pointed at `../font/acme-sans.woff2`, but the font actually lives in `site/fonts/` (plural). The browser requested `/font/acme-sans.woff2`, got a 404, and fell back to the system font — which changes the typography, spacing, and text wrapping on every page at every size. That's why it looked like the whole site changed at once.

This was easy to miss because computed styles and the DOM were unchanged (the CSS still *declares* `Acme Sans`); the visual report's capture-health check is what surfaced the failed font request, and the diff touched all 12 snapshots (2–15% of pixels).

**Fix:** Corrected the path to `../fonts/acme-sans.woff2`.

**Verification:**
- Visual: 12/12 snapshots match their approved baselines, 0 changed.
- Functional: 16/16 tests pass.
- The only file changed is `site/css/tokens.css` (one line).

STATUS: DONE
